statement: The WiiBrew Wiimote Bluetooth Communication / HID Interface sections report that later RVL-CNT-01-TR remotes require Bluetooth authentication before opening the HID data channel, while older RVL-CNT-01 devices could accept earlier or control-channel paths; the older SET_REPORT control-channel alternative is not supported by TR. This is community-documented radio/host behavior, not evidence for UHID or locally verified Bluetooth pairing.

applicability.revision: WiiBrew community documented Wii Remote family; precise physical hardware variant not independently captured
applicability.scope: WiiBrew oldid 123257 sections Bluetooth Communication; HID Interface. Physical Bluetooth implementation remains separately gated; local UHID Bluetooth bus metadata does not implement RF authentication.
